key_insight: Structural functional identifiability analysis can determine whether unknown observation maps and mechanistic parameters can be uniquely recovered from data.
engineering_relevance: This helps engineers assess whether hybrid mechanistic–neural models can recover meaningful sensor mappings and system parameters rather than merely fit observations.
method: Represent unknown observation maps with neural networks while preserving mechanistic differential equations.
Analyze map and parameter identifiability using differential algebra.
Prove general conditions for identifiability and non-identifiability.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports theoretical results and a general analysis methodology, but provides no quantitative benchmarks or dataset-level evaluation details.
watch_item: Structural identifiability does not guarantee reliable recovery from noisy, finite data or successful neural-network training.
paper_title: Structural functional identifiability of unknown differential equation observation maps
